Recorded claim:
browser_autoTreeView.js checks initial column labels and visibility, picker order and state, text and accessible labels, sort direction and persisted values, visibility, drag reorder, resize, restore, reopened-tab restoration, UI density, and invalid column IDs. It removes the test URL from xulStore in cleanup. A reviewer reported --verify failures around drag and resize that were not reproduced by the author, so drag tests have an identified intermittent risk. Use a behavior matrix and clean saved state when testing reusable tree widgets.
